About the job

Marketing Recruiter & Business Support (Digital Marketing & Creative Recruiting)

Remote | Full-time | 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern (flexible) | Fluent English required




Salary: $800 to $1,300 USD per month plus performance bonuses, based on experience.




About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a women-owned NYC eyewear brand, growing fast, building luxury sunglasses that solve real problems: floating sunnies, tangle-free aviators, foldable pocket frames, and mood-boosting lenses. We are a small team and a small business, not corporate at all, and it is a fun brand to be part of. We are close-knit and supportive, and everyone here wears many hats and jumps in wherever they are needed.




Our biggest opportunity right now is building an exceptional marketing team. We believe that great companies are built by great people, and finding those people is one of the highest-impact jobs in the company. We are looking for someone who loves recruiting, understands digital marketing (to ask very detailed skill based questions), and gets excited about finding the people who will help TopFoxx grow for years to come.




The Role

This is not a traditional HR recruiter position, and it is not simply posting jobs and scheduling interviews. Your job is to build a world-class marketing team.




You will own the recruiting process for our marketing and creative departments, partnering directly with leadership to understand every role, identify exceptional talent, and hire people who can make a measurable impact on our business.




We are looking for someone who understands marketing well enough to recognize great marketers. You don't need to be the person running Meta Ads or creating videos yourself, but you should understand what separates an average candidate from an exceptional one. You care about quality over quantity. You believe hiring one outstanding person beats hiring ten average ones, and you would rather send us three excellent candidates than thirty adequate ones.




The 80/20 Structure

This role is expected to be approximately:




80% Recruiting & Talent Acquisition

Your primary focus will always be finding, evaluating, and helping us hire exceptional people, particularly across marketing, creative, e-commerce, and growth roles.




20% Marketing, HR, Project & Business Support

We're a lean and growing company, so when recruiting volume is lighter or another priority needs additional support, you'll have the opportunity to contribute beyond recruiting.




Depending on your strengths and current company priorities, this could include supporting marketing-related projects, research, project coordination, HR initiatives, documentation, process improvement, team engagement, administrative projects, or other cross-functional business needs.




We're looking for someone who enjoys recruiting but is also curious, adaptable, and willing to jump into new challenges when they can make an impact.




What Success Looks Like

You are successful when TopFoxx consistently hires exceptional marketing talent that helps the business grow.




Day to day, that means you:

Build strong pipelines before hiring becomes urgent.
Present hiring managers with highly qualified candidates instead of large numbers of average applicants.
Fill marketing positions quickly without sacrificing quality.
Identify candidates who demonstrate ownership, problem-solving, communication, and execution.
Create an excellent candidate experience from first contact through onboarding.
Support new team members during their first month by helping them integrate into the company and successfully transition into their role.
Help onboard team members by sharing bonus plans, setting clear KPIs, and ensuring they understand how success will be measured.
Proactively source top talent from other companies through LinkedIn and other professional networks.
Continuously improve our recruiting process so hiring becomes faster, more consistent, and more data-driven.
Keep recruiting organized with accurate trackers, interview notes, scorecards, bonus plans and documentation.




What You'll Recruit For

You'll primarily recruit for marketing and creative positions, including:




Paid Media: Meta Ads Specialists, TikTok Ads Specialists & Performance Marketing Managers

Creative: Video Editors, Creative Strategists, Graphic Designers & UGC Creators

Lifecycle Marketing: Email Marketing & SMS Marketing Specialists, Digital marketing specialists

E-commerce Marketing: Growth Marketing Specialists, Shopify Marketing, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

Partnerships: Affiliate Marketing Managers & Influencer Marketing Managers

Sales: Wholesale Sales Representatives & E-commerce Sales Professionals




As TopFoxx grows, you'll also help recruit future marketing leadership positions.




What You'll Oversee (Key Responsibilities)




1) Full-Cycle Recruiting

Own the complete recruitment process from intake meeting through offer acceptance.
Partner with hiring managers to fully understand each position before recruiting begins.
Write compelling, high-converting job advertisements.
Post jobs across multiple recruiting platforms.
Source passive candidates through LinkedIn and other channels.
Build talent pipelines for future hiring needs.
Review resumes, portfolios, and applications.
Conduct structured interviews.
Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and leadership.
Perform reference checks when appropriate.
Keep candidates informed throughout the hiring process.
Present hiring recommendations supported by structured evaluations.




2) Candidate Evaluation

Evaluate candidates based on real ability, ownership, communication, and execution, not resumes alone.
Review portfolios, case studies, assessments, and work samples.
Identify high performers who align with TopFoxx's culture and expectations.
Build structured interview scorecards for every role.
Develop role-specific interview questions.
Recommend assessments that accurately measure job performance.




3) Recruiting Systems & Process Improvement

Build and improve recruiting workflows.
Create hiring playbooks and recruiting SOPs.
Maintain recruiting dashboards and hiring trackers.
Improve interview processes and candidate evaluation systems.
Keep recruiting documentation organized and up to date.
Continuously recommend ways to improve hiring quality and efficiency.




4) Partnership With Leadership

Meet regularly with hiring managers to understand hiring priorities.
Help define ideal candidate profiles before recruiting begins.
Ensure every position has clear expectations and measurable success criteria.
Keep leadership updated on recruiting progress, hiring challenges, and pipeline health.
Recommend improvements to job descriptions, compensation, interview processes, and recruiting strategy when appropriate.




5) Employer Branding & Candidate Experience

Represent TopFoxx professionally throughout the hiring process.
Write engaging candidate outreach messages.
Ensure every candidate has a positive experience, regardless of hiring outcome.
Help strengthen TopFoxx's reputation as an employer of choice.




6) Onboarding Support

Assisting with onboarding, employee experience, and company culture initiatives.
Helping coordinate cross-functional projects.
Ensure candidates receive the information, tools, and documentation needed before their first day.
Partner with hiring managers to help new hires transition successfully into their roles.




7) Additional Support & Cross-Functional Projects

When recruiting needs are lighter, or as business needs evolve, you may also support other areas of the company based on your skills and priorities. This may include:

Supporting project management and cross-functional projects when additional help is needed.
Supporting other operational or organizational projects as the company grows.
Helping coordinate marketing projects and follow-ups.
Supporting special projects from marketing leadership or the Founder.
Helping create or improve SOPs and internal processes.
Supporting HR and administrative projects.
Researching solutions to business or operational problems.
Taking ownership of other projects where your skills can help the company move faster.




This role is primarily focused on recruiting, but as TopFoxx continues to grow, there may be opportunities to develop your skills and take on additional responsibilities in areas where you can make a meaningful impact.

About the job

Sales Executive – Enterprise Business Applications & Agentic AI | México




Technology Coast Partners (TCP) is growing in México, and we are looking for a Sales Executive to develop new business with mid-market manufacturing and distribution companies.

TCP helps manufacturers and distributors transform their businesses through enterprise business applications and Agentic AI, connecting operations, supply chains, customers, people, and data to improve productivity, profitability, and growth.


The Role




This is a new-business development and consultative sales position.

We are looking for someone who is curious about how manufacturers and distributors operate, comfortable engaging senior executives, and capable of connecting business challenges with technology-driven solutions.

You will work with CEOs, CFOs, COOs, Operations and Supply Chain leaders, Commercial Directors, and IT executives to identify opportunities where enterprise applications, automation, data, and Agentic AI can create measurable business value.


What You'll Do




Develop new accounts within the Mexican mid-market manufacturing and distribution sector
Prospect and engage senior executives through LinkedIn, email, phone, events, webinars, referrals, and other channels
Build and manage a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities
Conduct discovery to understand customers' operational and commercial challenges
Develop relationships with C-level, Operations, Supply Chain, Commercial, and IT leaders
Work with TCP's consulting and technical teams to develop solutions and business cases
Manage opportunities from initial engagement through proposal, negotiation, and closing
Participate in industry events and manufacturing and distribution communities across México
We're Looking For
3+ years of successful B2B sales experience
A demonstrated ability to prospect, develop new accounts, and generate pipeline
Experience with technology, enterprise applications, SaaS, AI, consulting, industrial technology, or related solutions
Experience working with manufacturing or distribution companies is strongly preferred
Ability to engage C-level and senior operational executives
Curiosity about how businesses operate and how technology can improve them
Interest in the rapidly evolving role of Agentic AI in manufacturing and distribution
Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
Professional Spanish; English proficiency strongly preferred


Why TCP?




Enterprise technology is entering a new phase.

Enterprise business applications have long provided the operational foundation for manufacturers and distributors. Agentic AI is now creating an intelligent layer across those systems, enabling companies to automate workflows, access information differently, augment their people, and rethink how work gets done.

At TCP, you won't simply sell software features. You'll work with business leaders to understand their operations and help them use technology to become more productive, responsive, profitable, and competitive.

Location: México

Travel: Within México as required

Compensation: Competitive base salary + performance-based variable compensation




If you enjoy creating new business, talking with business leaders, understanding how companies actually operate, and helping manufacturers and distributors solve meaningful problems, we'd like to hear from you.




Join Technology Coast Partners and help shape the next generation of intelligent manufacturing and distribution in México.

Our client is a growing architecture and design firm based on the East Coast of the USA, specializing in residential and commercial design solutions.




Job Description:

Our client is seeking an experienced sales professional with a background in architecture, renovations, construction, or real estate development. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying potential clients, generating new business opportunities, nurturing leads, and closing sales for their architecture and design services. This is a part-time remote position with a competitive commission structure, making it an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives in a performance-based environment.




Responsibilities of the role:

• Identify and source new business opportunities through networking, outreach, referrals, and prospecting.

• Build relationships with homeowners, developers, real estate professionals, contractors, and other potential clients.

• Qualify leads and manage the sales pipeline from initial contact through closing.

• Conduct discovery calls and present the firm's architecture and design services.

• Prepare proposals and coordinate with the design team as needed.

• Follow up consistently with prospects to move opportunities through the sales process.

• Meet or exceed monthly sales and revenue goals.

• Maintain accurate records of leads, client interactions, and sales activities in the CRM.




Required Experience and Qualifications:

• Proven experience in business development, sales, or account management.

• Previous experience in the architecture, renovations, construction, or real estate development industry is required.

• Demonstrated ability to generate leads and close sales.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

• Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple prospects simultaneously.

• Proficiency with CRM software and Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.




Preferred Skills:

• Existing network within the architecture, construction, or real estate industry.

• Experience selling professional services or high-value projects.

• Knowledge of architectural design, permitting, or renovation processes.




Personality:

• Enjoys networking, building long-term client relationships, and turning opportunities into successful projects.




Software & Tools:

• CRM software

• Microsoft Office or Google Workspace




Schedule:

Part-Time

Flexible, with availability during U.S. East Coast business hours preferred.




Salary and Benefits:

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

• Full-time remote opportunity.
